item.title: Who is Jay Mehta? Meet Juhi Chawla’s husband selling half of his 45% KKR stake for $400 million
item.description: Jay Mehta, husband of actor Juhi Chawla and a director of the Mehta Group, is reportedly set to sell half of his 45% stake in Kolkata Knight Riders to US-based Ares Management for $400 million. The deal would value the IPL franchise at around $1.78 billion, subject to BCCI approval.

item.title: Tukaram Mundhe's FDA suspends licences of Blinkit, Chaayos, 5 Spice among 6 Mumbai establishments: What inspection found
item.description: Mumbai FDA suspended the licences of six establishments after inspections uncovered serious hygiene violations, including cockroaches, flies, uncovered dustbins, unsafe food storage and faulty equipment. The regulator said the breaches of food safety standards posed a public health threat.

item.title: Who is Travis Kalanick? What Uber co-founder is planning after Jensen Huang episode at Nvidia; details here
item.description: Uber co-founder Travis Kalanick says he may demonstrate at Nvidia’s headquarters to support efforts to bring back former CEO Jensen Huang. His comments join public appeals from technology leaders and investors, although Nvidia’s board has indicated it does not plan to reinstate Huang.

item.title: केंद्रीय मंत्री चौहान ने मुर्गियों को बर्ड फ़्लू से बचाने के लिए देश के पहले स्वदेशी H5N1 वैक्सीन का अनावरण किया
item.description: केंद्रीय मंत्री शिवराज सिंह चौहान ने भारत में विकसित मुर्गियों के लिए पहले स्वदेशी H5N1 टीके का अनावरण किया। यह महत्त्वपूर्ण वैक्सीन भोपाल स्थित आईसीएआर-नेशनल इंस्टिट्यूट ऑफ़ हाई सिक्योरिटी एनिमल डिसीज़ ने तैयार की है। केंद्रीय कृषि मंत्रालय के अधिकारियों ने इसकी अहमियत पर ज़ोर दिया।
